annotations.description: {{ $labels.node }} has been unready for more than 15 minutes.
annotations.summary: Node is not ready.

annotations.description: {{ $labels.node }} has active Condition {{ $labels.condition }}. This is caused by resource usage exceeding eviction thresholds.
annotations.summary: Node has as active Condition.

annotations.description: {{ $labels.node }} is unreachable and some workloads may be rescheduled.
annotations.summary: Node is unreachable.

annotations.description: Kubelet '{{ $labels.node }}' is running at {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} of its Pod capacity.
annotations.summary: Kubelet is running at capacity.

model.expr: (   max by (cluster, instance) (     kubelet_running_pods{job="kubelet"} > 1   )   * on (cluster, instance) group_left(node)   max by (cluster, instance, node) (     kubelet_node_name{job="kubelet"}   ) ) / on (cluster, node) group_left() max by (cluster, node) (   kube_node_status_capacity{job="kube-state-metrics", resource="pods"} != 1 ) > 0.95

annotations.description: The readiness status of node {{ $labels.node }} has changed {{ $value }} times in the last 15 minutes.
annotations.summary: Node readiness status is flapping.

annotations.description: Node {{ $labels.node }} is evicting Pods due to {{ $labels.eviction_signal }}.  Eviction occurs when eviction thresholds are crossed, typically caused by Pods exceeding RAM/ephemeral-storage limits.
annotations.summary: Node is evicting pods.

model.expr: sum(rate(kubelet_evictions{job="kubelet"}[15m])) by(cluster, eviction_signal, instance) * on (cluster, instance) group_left(node) max by (cluster, instance, node) (   kubelet_node_name{job="kubelet"} ) > 0

annotations.description: The Kubelet Pod Lifecycle Event Generator has a 99th percentile duration of {{ $value }} seconds on node {{ $labels.node }}.
annotations.summary: Kubelet Pod Lifecycle Event Generator is taking too long to relist.

annotations.description: Kubelet Pod startup 99th percentile latency is {{ $value }} seconds on node {{ $labels.node }}.
annotations.summary: Kubelet Pod startup latency is too high.

model.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(kubelet_pod_worker_duration_seconds_bucket{job="kubelet"}[5m])) by (cluster, instance, le)) * on(cluster, instance) group_left(node) kubelet_node_name{job="kubelet"} > 60

annotations.description: Client certificate for Kubelet on node {{ $labels.node }} expires in {{ $value | humanizeDuration }}.
annotations.summary: Kubelet client certificate is about to expire.

annotations.description: Client certificate for Kubelet on node {{ $labels.node }} expires in {{ $value | humanizeDuration }}.
annotations.summary: Kubelet client certificate is about to expire.

annotations.description: Server certificate for Kubelet on node {{ $labels.node }} expires in {{ $value | humanizeDuration }}.
annotations.summary: Kubelet server certificate is about to expire.

annotations.description: Server certificate for Kubelet on node {{ $labels.node }} expires in {{ $value | humanizeDuration }}.
annotations.summary: Kubelet server certificate is about to expire.

annotations.description: Kubelet on node {{ $labels.node }} has failed to renew its client certificate ({{ $value | humanize }} errors in the last 5 minutes).
annotations.summary: Kubelet has failed to renew its client certificate.

annotations.description: Kubelet on node {{ $labels.node }} has failed to renew its server certificate ({{ $value | humanize }} errors in the last 5 minutes).
annotations.summary: Kubelet has failed to renew its server certificate.

annotations.description: Kubelet has disappeared from Prometheus target discovery.
annotations.summary: Target disappeared from Prometheus target discovery.

annotations.description: Pod {{ $labels.namespace }}/{{ $labels.pod }} ({{ $labels.container }}) is in waiting state (reason: "CrashLoopBackOff").
annotations.summary: Pod is crash looping.

annotations.description: Pod {{ $labels.namespace }}/{{ $labels.pod }} has been in a non-ready state for longer than 15 minutes.
annotations.summary: Pod has been in a non-ready state for more than 15 minutes.

model.expr: sum by (namespace, pod, cluster) (   max by(namespace, pod, cluster) (     kube_pod_status_phase{job="kube-state-metrics", phase=~"Pending|Unknown|Failed"}   ) * on(namespace, pod, cluster) group_left(owner_kind) topk by(namespace, pod, cluster) (     1, max by(namespace, pod, owner_kind, cluster) (kube_pod_owner{owner_kind!="Job"})   ) ) > 0

annotations.description: Deployment generation for {{ $labels.namespace }}/{{ $labels.deployment }} does not match, this indicates that the Deployment has failed but has not been rolled back.
annotations.summary: Deployment generation mismatch due to possible roll-back

annotations.description: Deployment {{ $labels.namespace }}/{{ $labels.deployment }} has not matched the expected number of replicas for longer than 15 minutes.
annotations.summary: Deployment has not matched the expected number of replicas.

annotations.description: Rollout of deployment {{ $labels.namespace }}/{{ $labels.deployment }} is not progressing for longer than 15 minutes.
annotations.summary: Deployment rollout is not progressing.

annotations.description: StatefulSet {{ $labels.namespace }}/{{ $labels.statefulset }} has not matched the expected number of replicas for longer than 15 minutes.
annotations.summary: StatefulSet has not matched the expected number of replicas.

annotations.description: StatefulSet generation for {{ $labels.namespace }}/{{ $labels.statefulset }} does not match, this indicates that the StatefulSet has failed but has not been rolled back.
annotations.summary: StatefulSet generation mismatch due to possible roll-back

annotations.description: StatefulSet {{ $labels.namespace }}/{{ $labels.statefulset }} update has not been rolled out.
annotations.summary: StatefulSet update has not been rolled out.

model.expr: (   max by(namespace, statefulset, job, cluster) (     kube_statefulset_status_current_revision{job="kube-state-metrics"}       unless     kube_statefulset_status_update_revision{job="kube-state-metrics"}   )     *   (     kube_statefulset_replicas{job="kube-state-metrics"}       !=     kube_statefulset_status_replicas_updated{job="kube-state-metrics"}   ) )  and (   changes(kube_statefulset_status_replicas_updated{job="kube-state-metrics"}[5m])     ==   0 )

annotations.description: DaemonSet {{ $labels.namespace }}/{{ $labels.daemonset }} has not finished or progressed for at least 15m.
annotations.summary: DaemonSet rollout is stuck.

annotations.description: pod/{{ $labels.pod }} in namespace {{ $labels.namespace }} on container {{ $labels.container}} has been in waiting state for longer than 1 hour. (reason: "{{ $labels.reason }}").
annotations.summary: Pod container waiting longer than 1 hour

annotations.description: {{ $value }} Pods of DaemonSet {{ $labels.namespace }}/{{ $labels.daemonset }} are not scheduled.
annotations.summary: DaemonSet pods are not scheduled.

annotations.description: {{ $value }} Pods of DaemonSet {{ $labels.namespace }}/{{ $labels.daemonset }} are running where they are not supposed to run.
annotations.summary: DaemonSet pods are misscheduled.

annotations.description: Job {{ $labels.namespace }}/{{ $labels.job_name }} is taking more than {{ "43200" | humanizeDuration }} to complete.
annotations.summary: Job did not complete in time

model.expr: time() - max by(namespace, job_name, cluster) (kube_job_status_start_time{job="kube-state-metrics"}   and kube_job_status_active{job="kube-state-metrics"} > 0) > 43200

annotations.description: Job {{ $labels.namespace }}/{{ $labels.job_name }} failed to complete. Removing failed job after investigation should clear this alert.
annotations.summary: Job failed to complete.

annotations.description: HPA {{ $labels.namespace }}/{{ $labels.horizontalpodautoscaler  }} has not matched the desired number of replicas for longer than 15 minutes.
annotations.summary: HPA has not matched desired number of replicas.

annotations.description: HPA {{ $labels.namespace }}/{{ $labels.horizontalpodautoscaler  }} has been running at max replicas for longer than 15 minutes.
annotations.summary: HPA is running at max replicas
Cluster has overcommitted CPU resource requests.

annotations.description: Cluster has overcommitted memory resource requests for Pods by {{ $value | humanize }} bytes and cannot tolerate node failure.
annotations.summary: Cluster has overcommitted memory resource requests.

annotations.description: Cluster has overcommitted CPU resource requests for Namespaces.
annotations.summary: Cluster has overcommitted CPU resource requests.

annotations.description: Cluster has overcommitted memory resource requests for Namespaces.
annotations.summary: Cluster has overcommitted memory resource requests.

annotations.description: Namespace {{ $labels.namespace }} is using {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} of its {{ $labels.resource }} quota.
annotations.summary: Namespace quota is going to be full.

annotations.description: Namespace {{ $labels.namespace }} is using {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} of its {{ $labels.resource }} quota.
annotations.summary: Namespace quota is fully used.

annotations.description: Namespace {{ $labels.namespace }} is using {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} of its {{ $labels.resource }} quota.
annotations.summary: Namespace quota has exceeded the limits.

annotations.description: {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} throttling of CPU in namespace {{ $labels.namespace }} for container {{ $labels.container }} in pod {{ $labels.pod }}.
annotations.summary: Processes experience elevated CPU throttling.

model.expr: sum(increase(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{container!="", job="cadvisor", }[5m])) without (id, metrics_path, name, image, endpoint, job, node)   / on (cluster, namespace, pod, container, instance) group_left sum(increase(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{job="cadvisor", }[5m])) without (id, metrics_path, name, image, endpoint, job, node)   > ( 25 / 100 )

annotations.description: The PersistentVolume claimed by {{ $labels.persistentvolumeclaim }} in Namespace {{ $labels.namespace }} {{ if $labels.cluster }} on Cluster {{ $labels.cluster }} {{end}} is only {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} free.
annotations.summary: PersistentVolume is filling up.

model.expr: (   kubelet_volume_stats_available_bytes{job="kubelet"}     /   kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{job="kubelet"} ) < 0.03 and kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{job="kubelet"} > 0 unless on(cluster, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) kube_persistentvolumeclaim_access_mode{ access_mode="ReadOnlyMany"} == 1 unless on(cluster, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) kube_persistentvolumeclaim_labels{label_excluded_from_alerts="true"} == 1

annotations.description: Based on recent sampling, the PersistentVolume claimed by {{ $labels.persistentvolumeclaim }} in Namespace {{ $labels.namespace }} {{ if $labels.cluster }} on Cluster {{ $labels.cluster }} {{end}} is expected to fill up within four days. Currently {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} is available.
annotations.summary: PersistentVolume is filling up.

model.expr: (   kubelet_volume_stats_available_bytes{job="kubelet"}     /   kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{job="kubelet"} ) < 0.15 and kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{job="kubelet"} > 0 and predict_linear(kubelet_volume_stats_available_bytes{job="kubelet"}[6h], 4 * 24 * 3600) < 0 unless on(cluster, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) kube_persistentvolumeclaim_access_mode{ access_mode="ReadOnlyMany"} == 1 unless on(cluster, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) kube_persistentvolumeclaim_labels{label_excluded_from_alerts="true"} == 1

annotations.description: The PersistentVolume claimed by {{ $labels.persistentvolumeclaim }} in Namespace {{ $labels.namespace }} {{ if $labels.cluster }} on Cluster {{ $labels.cluster }} {{end}} only has {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} free inodes.
annotations.summary: PersistentVolumeInodes are filling up.

model.expr: (   kubelet_volume_stats_inodes_free{job="kubelet"}     /   kubelet_volume_stats_inodes{job="kubelet"} ) < 0.03 and kubelet_volume_stats_inodes_used{job="kubelet"} > 0 unless on(cluster, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) kube_persistentvolumeclaim_access_mode{ access_mode="ReadOnlyMany"} == 1 unless on(cluster, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) kube_persistentvolumeclaim_labels{label_excluded_from_alerts="true"} == 1

annotations.description: Based on recent sampling, the PersistentVolume claimed by {{ $labels.persistentvolumeclaim }} in Namespace {{ $labels.namespace }} {{ if $labels.cluster }} on Cluster {{ $labels.cluster }} {{end}} is expected to run out of inodes within four days. Currently {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} of its inodes are free.
annotations.summary: PersistentVolumeInodes are filling up.

model.expr: (   kubelet_volume_stats_inodes_free{job="kubelet"}     /   kubelet_volume_stats_inodes{job="kubelet"} ) < 0.15 and kubelet_volume_stats_inodes_used{job="kubelet"} > 0 and predict_linear(kubelet_volume_stats_inodes_free{job="kubelet"}[6h], 4 * 24 * 3600) < 0 unless on(cluster, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) kube_persistentvolumeclaim_access_mode{ access_mode="ReadOnlyMany"} == 1 unless on(cluster, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) kube_persistentvolumeclaim_labels{label_excluded_from_alerts="true"} == 1

annotations.description: The persistent volume {{ $labels.persistentvolume }} {{ if $labels.cluster }} on Cluster {{ $labels.cluster }} {{end}} has status {{ $labels.phase }}.
annotations.summary: PersistentVolume is having issues with provisioning.

annotations.description: There are {{ $value }} different semantic versions of Kubernetes components running.
annotations.summary: Different semantic versions of Kubernetes components running.

annotations.description: Kubernetes API server client '{{ $labels.job }}/{{ $labels.instance }}' is experiencing {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} errors.
annotations.summary: Kubernetes API server client is experiencing errors.

model.expr: (sum(rate(rest_client_requests_total{job="kube-apiserver",code=~"5.."}[5m])) by (cluster, instance, job, namespace)   / sum(rate(rest_client_requests_total{job="kube-apiserver"}[5m])) by (cluster, instance, job, namespace)) > 0.01
